name: Cloudmonster 2 Running Shoe
description: Maximum cushioning with On's signature CloudTec sole for explosive energy return on road surfaces. Designed for long-distance training and race day, featuring a breathable mesh upper and rocker geometry. Ideal for women seeking plush protection without sacrificing speed during summer marathon training or long weekend runs on pavement.

name: Cloud X 3 Cross-Training Shoe
description: The ultimate do-everything trainer for women who move between the gym floor, treadmill, and outdoor runs. CloudTec Phase cushioning adapts to your stride whether you're lifting, doing HIIT, or heading out for a summer tempo run. A hybrid training shoe built for athletes who refuse to choose just one workout.

name: Cloudsurfer 7 Running Shoe
description: Effortless daily running for men who want a smooth, natural ride without compromising responsiveness. The CloudTec sole and Speedboard work together to propel you forward with each footstrike. A refined upper with engineered mesh keeps feet cool and locked in on summer road runs from 5K to half marathon distances.

name: Air Zoom Pegasus 41
description: Nike's most trusted daily trainer, updated for women with a wider forefoot and improved zoom air cushioning. The Pegasus 41 handles everything from easy recovery miles to faster tempo runs on summer roads. A plush heel and responsive forefoot make it the go-to shoe for women building weekly mileage year-round.

name: Air Zoom Pegasus 41
description: The workhorse of the Nike running lineup for men, trusted by runners of all levels for its reliable cushioning and responsive ride. Zoom Air pods provide pop off the ground, while React foam delivers long-lasting comfort on summer road miles. Fits a wide range of foot shapes for all-day comfort.

name: Vaporfly 3 Racing Shoe
description: Nike's elite marathon racing shoe for competitive women runners. The full-length carbon fiber plate and ZoomX foam deliver record-breaking energy return and forward propulsion. Designed for race day when every second counts — a proven performer on summer marathon courses and road races from 10K to ultramarathon distance.

name: Ultraboost Light 24 Running Shoe
description: The lightest Ultraboost ever made, now with improved Boost foam for women who want cloud-like cushioning on every road run. Responsive energy return keeps you moving through long summer training runs, while the Primeknit+ upper wraps the foot in adaptive comfort. A premium road runner that handles daily miles and long runs equally well.

name: Adizero SL 2 Running Shoe
description: Adidas speed-inspired daily trainer for men who want race-day feel at everyday price. Lightweight Lightstrike Pro foam and a Continental rubber outsole provide fast, grippy performance on summer road runs and tempo workouts. A stripped-back build that keeps weight minimal without sacrificing durability on high-mileage training cycles.

name: Ghost 16 Running Shoe
description: Brooks' most popular women's daily runner, refined with improved DNA Loft v3 cushioning for a smoother, softer ride. The Ghost 16 accommodates a wide range of foot types and running styles, from early-morning easy runs to summer long runs. Reliable, durable, and forgiving — the neutral trainer women come back to season after season.

name: Adrenaline GTS 24 Running Shoe
description: The gold standard in men's supportive daily running shoes. Brooks' GuideRails technology keeps excess motion in check without overcorrecting, protecting knees and hips during high-mileage summer training. DNA Loft v3 cushioning delivers a plush, smooth ride on pavement. The Adrenaline GTS is the trusted choice for men needing a reliable stability shoe.

name: Clifton 9 Running Shoe
description: Hoka's iconic maximally cushioned road shoe for women who prioritize comfort on every run. The Clifton 9 wraps feet in a soft, compression-molded EVA midsole that absorbs impact and reduces fatigue on long summer training days. A meta-rocker geometry encourages smooth toe-off, making it equally effective for recovery runs and daily mileage.

name: HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe
description: Under Armour's smart daily trainer for men who want GPS-connected insights built into every run. The HOVR Sonic 6 pairs with the UA MapMyRun app to capture cadence, stride length, and form metrics in real time. HOVR foam delivers zero-gravity cushioning for comfortable summer road runs from 5K to 10-mile training sessions.

name: Speedcross 6 Trail Running Shoe
description: The ultimate aggressive trail shoe for men tackling muddy, technical terrain. Salomon's iconic chevron lug pattern bites into soft ground with unrelenting grip, while the protective toe cap and cushioned midsole handle rocky mountain descents. Preferred by trail racers and adventure runners who push hard through wet, rooted summer singletrack.

name: S/LAB Ultra 3 Trail Shoe
description: Salomon's pinnacle ultramarathon racing shoe for elite male trail runners. Built for 50K to 100-mile mountain races, the S/LAB Ultra 3 combines a lightweight chassis with exceptional ground feel and forefoot protection. The Contragrip MA outsole grips dry to wet technical terrain through alpine summer races and multi-day adventures.

name: Sense Ride 5 Trail Running Shoe
description: Salomon's most versatile trail runner for women who run mixed terrain — from groomed singletrack to fire roads and light pavement. The Sense Ride 5 delivers efficient propulsion through a responsive chassis and Wet Traction Contragrip outsole. Lightweight and breathable for summer trail runs where conditions change mile by mile.

name: Cloudvista 2 Trail Running Shoe
description: On Running's trail shoe for women who demand performance on technical mountain terrain without sacrificing comfort. The Cloudvista 2 features a grippy Missiongrip outsole and Mission Cushioning system that adapts to uneven trail surfaces. Perfect for summer alpine adventures, technical singletracks, and women's trail races from 10K to marathon.

name: Cascadia 17 Trail Running Shoe
description: Brooks' hardworking trail shoe for men who cover serious mountain miles. The Cascadia 17 features a rock plate to protect against sharp debris, TrailTack rubber for multi-surface grip, and ample midsole cushioning for long days on rugged trails. A go-to choice for men running mountain 50Ks or just exploring technical summer singletrack.

name: Speedgoat 5 Trail Running Shoe
description: Hoka's most iconic mountain trail shoe for women, named after the legendary Hardrock 100 course. Massive Vibram Megagrip lugs dominate technical mountain terrain, while maximalist cushioning protects legs on long summer descents. The Speedgoat 5 is the trusted weapon for women tackling technical ultras, mountain races, and big adventure days.

name: Wildhorse 8 Trail Running Shoe
description: Nike's accessible trail runner for men who are stepping off the road onto their first trails. The Wildhorse 8 delivers reliable grip on packed dirt and rocky terrain with multi-directional lugs, plus a rock shield for underfoot protection. A durable and versatile choice for summer trail runs that don't require extreme technical performance.

name: Norvan LD 3 Trail Running Shoe
description: Arc'teryx precision engineering meets long-distance trail running in the Norvan LD 3. Designed for men covering technical mountain terrain for hours at a time, featuring a GORE-TEX membrane, Vibram Megagrip outsole, and a fit that locks the heel for technical descents. The go-to shoe for men's alpine summer adventures and technical mountain ultras.

name: Swiftly Tech Long Sleeve 2.0
description: Lululemon's best-selling long sleeve running top for women. Sweat-wicking Nulu fabric keeps you cool and dry during hot summer runs, while the flatlock seams eliminate chafing on long-distance efforts. The slim, form-fitting silhouette stays in place during workouts and looks polished post-run. Women's road runners and gym athletes reach for this every time.

name: Fast and Free T-Shirt
description: Lightweight and breathable women's running tee engineered for summer performance. Lululemon's Ultralu fabric moves sweat away fast, while the relaxed fit provides freedom of movement without excess bulk. Reflective details add visibility on early-morning or evening runs. A versatile top that transitions seamlessly from morning run to weekend errands.

name: Dri-FIT ADV Vapor Singlet
description: Nike's race-day singlet for competitive women runners who demand maximum breathability and minimum weight. Dri-FIT ADV technology actively moves sweat away from skin, keeping you cooler in summer heat than standard moisture-wicking fabrics. The open mesh construction and streamlined silhouette reduce wind resistance on the track, road, and at finish lines.

name: Dri-FIT Miler Running Top
description: Nike's reliable everyday running top for men who want performance without the premium price tag. Dri-FIT fabric keeps you dry through tempo runs and long summer training sessions, while the lightweight construction and open back improve ventilation. Reflective elements enhance visibility in low-light conditions before and after work.

name: Streaker 3.0 Short Sleeve
description: Under Armour's featherweight running tee for men who want to feel unrestricted on summer runs. UA's Microthread construction wicks sweat and dries extremely fast without absorbing moisture, keeping the shirt light even in hot, humid conditions. A no-frills, high-performance top that disappears on the body during long training runs.

name: HeatGear Fitted Long Sleeve
description: Under Armour's fitted compression long sleeve for men who train hard in summer heat. HeatGear fabric is ultra-lightweight and wicks sweat away in a flash, keeping skin cool and dry. The tight, mapped fit moves with the body during gym training, running, and cross-training without bunching or binding under other layers.

name: Cormac Crew Short Sleeve
description: Arc'teryx technical performance tee for men who move between trail running, hiking, and everyday adventure. Lightweight Phasic SL fabric delivers exceptional breathability and rapid moisture transport for sustained high-output summer activity. A clean, versatile cut that performs on mountain trails and looks equally at home in the city post-adventure.

name: Norvan SL Hoody
description: Arc'teryx's trail running shell for men who need weather protection without sacrificing movement or adding weight. Lumin SL fabric is highly wind resistant and water repellent, yet breathes well during high-intensity summer mountain efforts. Packs into its own pocket for easy storage in a race vest. The choice of competitive male mountain runners worldwide.

name: Own the Run T-Shirt
description: Adidas everyday running tee for men built with Aeroready moisture management that keeps you feeling dry through summer heat and humidity. Engineered open-structure fabric promotes airflow during tempo runs and long training days. Reflective details on the front and back improve visibility during low-light runs before dawn or after dusk.

name: Running AEROREADY T-Shirt
description: Adidas women's running tee with Aeroready technology that absorbs moisture at the source, keeping skin dry and comfortable during summer training. A relaxed fit provides freedom of movement on easy runs and group fitness classes. The lightweight recycled fabric feels soft against skin and holds its shape wash after wash.

name: Fast and Free High-Rise Tight 25"
description: Lululemon's best-selling running tight for women who refuse to sacrifice storage or style. Nulux fabric is sweat-wicking, abrasion-resistant, and offers a barely-there feel during summer long runs. Multiple pockets including a hidden waistband pocket and side seam pockets keep essentials secure at any pace. The tight that lives in every serious woman runner's rotation.

name: Align High-Rise Pant 28"
description: The cult-favorite women's legging that started a revolution in athletic comfort. Lululemon's Nulu fabric is buttery-soft and weightless, making these the go-to choice for yoga, barre, Pilates, and rest-day wear. The high-rise waistband offers support and coverage, while the four-way stretch adapts to any movement or low-impact summer training session.

name: Tempo Luxe 3" Running Short
description: Nike's premium race-day short for women who want freedom of movement and premium feel. A soft, stretchy fabric and built-in liner provide coverage and confidence during summer road races and fast track workouts. The 3-inch inseam keeps legs free while a sweat-wicking finish maintains comfort from the gun to the finish line.

name: Challenger 5" Brief-Lined Short
description: Nike's dependable daily running short for men. Dri-FIT fabric keeps you cool and dry through summer training runs, while the 5-inch inseam and brief liner provide comfort and coverage without restricting stride. Small zip pockets secure a key or card. A no-fuss short built for consistent mileage in warm weather conditions.

name: Launch Elite 5" Running Short
description: Under Armour's elite training short for men who push hard through summer training blocks. Ultra-lightweight, woven fabric is treated with a water-repellent finish that sheds sweat and light rain. The secure zip pocket, reflective details, and liner brief make this a complete performance short for morning road runs, track sessions, and warm-weather races.

name: Fly-By 2.0 Printed Running Tight
description: Under Armour's expressive running tight for women who want performance and style. Compression fabric supports muscles during summer training runs, while moisture transport keeps skin dry. Side pockets with media management route headphone cords cleanly. A signature print gives this tight a distinctive look that stands out on the road or at the track.

name: Run It 3-Stripes Short
description: Adidas classic 3-stripes running short for men who value iconic style and everyday performance. Aeroready fabric delivers moisture management during summer training runs, while the lightweight, streamlined construction eliminates unnecessary bulk. An internal brief provides comfort and a zip pocket secures small essentials on longer runs.

name: Incendo Short 11"
description: Arc'teryx precision-cut trail running short for men who need technical performance on mountain terrain. Phasic SL knit fabric delivers exceptional breathability during high-output summer trail runs, while an internal brief and articulated patterning eliminate chafing on technical descents. Secure pockets and a clean aesthetic suit both mountain racing and alpine adventure.

name: Forerunner 965 GPS Running Watch
description: Garmin's flagship running smartwatch with a vibrant AMOLED display and comprehensive training metrics. The Forerunner 965 delivers precise GPS tracking, VO2 max estimation, recovery advisor, and Training Readiness scores to optimize every summer training cycle. Supports triathlon, trail, and road running modes with turn-by-turn navigation for unfamiliar routes.

name: Fenix 7X Sapphire Solar GPS Watch
description: Garmin's ultimate adventure multisport watch for athletes who refuse boundaries. Solar charging extends battery life beyond 37 days in smartwatch mode, essential for multi-day mountain adventures and summer ultra races. Topographic maps, ClimbPro, and ski resort maps are built in. Sapphire crystal lens and titanium bezel survive the world's most demanding terrain.

name: Forerunner 265S GPS Running Watch
description: Garmin's advanced GPS running watch sized for women who want premium training features in a refined package. The vivid AMOLED display is readable in bright summer sunlight, while Training Readiness, HRV Status, and Garmin Coach training plans help optimize every workout. Syncs seamlessly with Strava and other platforms for complete training ecosystem integration.

name: Vivosmart 5 Activity Tracker
description: Garmin's slim, smart fitness tracker for everyday health monitoring without the complexity of a full GPS watch. Tracks steps, sleep, stress, heart rate, and Body Battery energy levels throughout the day. Water-resistant for swimming and summer outdoor activities. A perfect gateway into the Garmin ecosystem for athletes new to performance tracking.

name: WF-SP800N Sport Earbuds
description: Sony's fully waterproof sport earbuds for athletes who train in all conditions. IP55 water resistance handles summer rain runs and sweaty gym sessions without skipping a beat. Up to 9 hours of battery life with noise cancelling on, plus an ambient sound mode for outdoor safety. Extra-bass EQ and secure Arc Supporter fit keep them locked in place.

name: HRM-Pro Plus Heart Rate Monitor
description: The most accurate heart rate monitoring available for serious runners and triathletes. The HRM-Pro Plus chest strap captures beat-to-beat heart rate with clinical-grade precision and broadcasts simultaneously to Garmin watches, cycling computers, and gym equipment. Also captures running dynamics — cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation — for comprehensive training analysis.

name: Active Skin 8 Set Hydration Vest
description: Salomon's race-proven trail running hydration vest for men competing in ultras and long mountain adventures. Dual front soft flasks provide immediate hydration without stopping, while 8 liters of organized storage handles all-day nutrition and gear. The Sensifit chassis wraps the torso snugly to eliminate bounce, even on the most technical summer mountain descents.

name: VaporAir 7L Women's Hydration Race Vest
description: Nathan's most advanced women's-specific hydration vest, engineered to fit the female torso without the bounce and chafing of unisex designs. The VaporAir 7L includes two 20oz soft flasks, back reservoir compatibility, and highly organized storage for nutrition, layers, and race-day essentials. A top choice for women racing summer trail ultras.

name: Mantis 26 Daypack
description: Arc'teryx's most organized and technical daypack for men who move between urban commutes and alpine adventures. Laminated construction keeps contents dry in summer mountain showers, while an intelligent organization system separates laptops, gear, and clothing without digging. The Mantis 26 transitions effortlessly from office to trail — the one bag that does everything.

name: Brasilia 9.5 Training Duffel
description: Nike's most popular gym duffel bag for athletes who need reliable storage without overthinking it. The Brasilia 9.5 fits a change of clothes, shoes, and all gym essentials with room to spare. A separate ventilated compartment keeps sweaty gear or shoes isolated from clean items. The iconic Nike design works as well for weekend travel as for daily gym use.

name: Undeniable 5.0 Medium Duffel
description: Under Armour's rugged gym duffel with a water-resistant exterior that protects gear in summer rain. The large main compartment handles a full change of kit, while separate vented and valuables pockets keep wet gear and electronics organized. UA's Storm technology repels water without sacrificing breathability — built for athletes who train in any condition.

name: Hydrobak Light 1.5L Hydration Pack
description: CamelBak's ultralight hands-free hydration solution for cyclists and runners who need water access without stopping. A 1.5-liter reservoir delivers a steady flow via the magnetic Crux bite valve, leaving hands completely free on technical terrain. Weighing just 270g loaded, the Hydrobak Light is virtually unnoticeable on summer rides and trail runs.

name: Dyna 6 Women's Trail Running Pack
description: Osprey's women's-specific trail running pack built to fit the female torso with minimal bounce on technical terrain. The Dyna 6 includes an integrated hydration sleeve, trekking pole attachment, and organized front pocket for nutrition and essentials. Women trail runners training for summer ultras or exploring long singletrack routes will appreciate its precise, supportive fit.

name: Hidden Comfort No-Show Running Socks
description: The sock that competitive runners worldwide trust to go the distance without blisters. Balega's plush mohair-blend cushioning protects hotspots on the ball and heel during summer long runs and races, while the no-show cut keeps things minimal in any shoe. Moisture-wicking Drynamix fiber keeps feet dry and blister-free from mile one to the finish line.

name: Silver No-Show Antimicrobial Socks
description: Balega's antimicrobial running sock for athletes who log serious summer mileage. Silver fibers woven throughout the fabric inhibit bacterial growth, keeping feet fresh and odor-free even after multi-hour training sessions. Medium cushioning in the heel and ball balances comfort and ground feel on road and track. Pairs perfectly with any minimalist running shoe.

name: Dri-FIT ADV Running Cap
description: Nike's high-performance running cap engineered to keep women cool and protected on summer road runs. Dri-FIT ADV technology moves sweat away faster than standard moisture-wicking fabrics, while the structured brim shields eyes from harsh sunlight. A reflective Nike swoosh improves visibility, and the adjustable back closure accommodates all head sizes and hair styles.

name: Sutro Lite Sweep Sport Sunglasses
description: Oakley's Prizm-lens sport sunglasses designed for road runners and cyclists who demand exceptional optical clarity in varying light conditions. The lightweight O-Matter frame and Unobtanium nose pad grip securely even when sweat-soaked during summer races. Prizm Road lenses enhance contrast on pavement, making it easier to spot road hazards and trail features at speed.

name: SpeedDraw Plus Insulated Handheld Flask
description: Nathan's ergonomic handheld hydration flask for runners who want easy water access on summer training runs without wearing a vest. The insulated sleeve keeps water cooler longer in hot conditions, while the soft BPA-free flask collapses as you drink, eliminating sloshing. A hand strap and expandable pocket for cards, phone, or nutrition complete the package.

name: Energy Gel Variety Pack 24ct
description: GU's best-selling 24-pack assortment of energy gels covering the full flavor range for runners who need reliable mid-run fueling. Each gel delivers 100 calories of complex and simple carbohydrates for immediate and sustained energy on long summer runs and races. Electrolytes replace sodium lost through sweat, preventing hyponatremia on hot days.

name: Baller Hat Run
description: Lululemon's running hat designed specifically for women who wear their hair up. The back opening accommodates high ponytails and buns without distorting the hat's shape, while the sweat-wicking Swift UL fabric keeps the brow dry on hot summer runs. A wide brim provides genuine sun protection, and an adjustable closure ensures a perfect fit.

name: FastChews Electrolyte Tablets 60ct
description: SaltStick's chewable electrolyte replacement tablets formulated to match the electrolyte profile of human sweat. Essential for runners covering long summer distances in heat and humidity, where sweat loss can deplete sodium, potassium, and magnesium rapidly. A 60-count bottle is enough for an entire summer training cycle. Flavored with real fruit for a pleasant mid-run taste.

name: Prime Percussive Therapy Massager
description: Theragun's most popular percussive massage gun for athletes who take recovery as seriously as training. The Prime delivers 16mm amplitude at five speed settings to flush lactic acid from fatigued muscles after long summer runs and hard workouts. An ergonomic handle reaches every muscle group independently, making it the go-to recovery tool for serious runners and triathletes.

name: Venom 2 Leg Heat + Vibration Wrap
description: Hyperice's wearable heat and vibration recovery device for runners battling tight calves, hamstrings, and IT bands. The Venom 2 Leg wrap combines targeted heat and oscillating vibration to increase blood flow, accelerate tissue recovery, and reduce post-run soreness. Use pre-run for warm-up or post-run to speed recovery after summer marathon training sessions.

name: GRID Foam Roller 13"
description: TriggerPoint's iconic multi-density foam roller trusted by professional athletes and physical therapists for myofascial release. The GRID pattern replicates a massage therapist's hands, applying targeted pressure to tight spots in calves, IT bands, and hamstrings after hard summer training. Hollow core construction supports up to 500 pounds and maintains its shape over years of daily use.

name: QUADBALLER Muscle Roller
description: TriggerPoint's targeted muscle roller for quad, calf, and IT band release. The hard-plastic roller core applies deep, consistent pressure while the textured surface provides multi-dimensional relief on large leg muscle groups. Compact enough to pack in a trail running vest or gym bag for immediate post-run recovery anywhere during summer training camps.

name: Resistance Bands Set 5-Pack
description: TheraBand's classic resistance band set used by physical therapists and athletes worldwide for injury prevention, strength training, and active recovery. Five progressively resistant bands cover beginner to advanced exercises for hips, glutes, and ankles — the key muscles for injury-free summer running. Lightweight and packable for travel, home training, and track warm-up routines.

name: Sport Elite Muscle Stimulator
description: Compex's professional-grade electrical muscle stimulation device used by elite runners, cyclists, and triathletes for active recovery, strength development, and injury rehabilitation. The Sport Elite delivers personalized programs that reduce delayed onset muscle soreness after intense summer training blocks. Four channels treat multiple muscle groups simultaneously for time-efficient recovery sessions.

name: Running Light LED Strip 5m
description: A 5-meter flexible LED strip light for home and room decoration. Features multiple color modes and music-sync capability for creating dynamic lighting effects. Comes with adhesive backing for easy installation along shelves, behind TVs, or under furniture. Includes a remote control for switching between 16 preset colors and brightness levels.

name: Running Gear Differential Set
description: Replacement differential and running gear set for Traxxas RC trucks and buggies. Includes front and rear differentials, drive shafts, and associated hardware for a complete drivetrain overhaul. Compatible with multiple Traxxas platforms including the Slash, Rustler, and Stampede. Precision-machined metal components deliver improved durability over stock plastic parts.

name: GP Pro Motorcycle Racing Gloves
description: Alpinestars' GP Pro motorcycle racing gloves featuring full-grain leather construction with carbon fiber knuckle protection. CE Level 2 certified for safety on road and track. The anatomical fit and pre-curved fingers reduce hand fatigue on long rides, while perforated leather panels improve ventilation. Compatible with touchscreen devices for navigation use.

name: Contour Saddle Pad
description: An English-style contour saddle pad designed for trail and arena riding. Quilted cotton exterior with moisture-wicking lining keeps the horse's back comfortable during long rides. Anatomical shaping follows the horse's spine for an even contact surface under any saddle. Available in multiple colors to coordinate with equestrian show or trail riding attire.

name: GP-7 Racing Helmet
description: Bell's entry-level karting helmet designed for go-kart tracks and youth motorsport. The aerodynamic composite shell meets CIK-FIA homologation standards for competitive karting events. An anti-fog visor and internal lining provide comfort during intense track sessions. Comes in multiple shell sizes for proper fit across youth and adult head dimensions.

name: Trophy Cam HD Trail Camera
description: Bushnell's Trophy Cam HD trail camera for wildlife monitoring and hunting scouting. Features 20MP image resolution, 1080p HD video, and a fast 0.3-second trigger speed to capture animals in motion. The low-glow infrared flash illuminates subjects at night without spooking deer, turkey, or other game. Weatherproof construction handles full outdoor exposure year-round.

name: Heritage Elite Riding Breeches
description: Ariat women's Heritage Elite full-seat breeches for dressage, jumping, and trail riding disciplines. A 4-way stretch fabric delivers unrestricted movement in the saddle, while a full-seat suede grip panel prevents sliding. Silicone waistband and belt loops offer a clean, professional look in the arena. Machine washable for easy care after muddy trail rides.

name: Speedway Nomex Racing Suit
description: Simpson's single-layer Nomex auto racing fire suit meeting SFI 3.2A/1 certification standards for oval track and road course competition. Quilted Nomex lining provides comfort during long stints in hot cockpits. Elastic waistband with zipper closure, epaulets for harness routing, and double-needle stitching throughout for durability in motorsport environments.

name: Platinum Finger Tab
description: Easton's Platinum finger tab for traditional bow and recurve archers. A split-finger design distributes draw weight evenly across the index and middle fingers, preventing string-induced calluses and improving release consistency. Leather face with adjustable spacer fits left and right-handed archers. A popular choice for target archers and traditional bowhunters alike.

name: Wademaster Chest Waders
description: Frogg Toggs Wademaster chest waders for fly fishing and general stream wading. A three-ply waterproof material keeps anglers dry while wading rivers, streams, and wetlands. Attached gravel guards keep debris out of wading boots. Adjustable shoulder straps and a front zippered pocket provide comfort and convenience during full days on the water.
